apiKey.description: API key for authentication. Falls back to OBJECTIVEAI_API_KEY env var.

apiBase.description: Base URL for the API. Falls back to OBJECTIVEAI_API_BASE env var, then https://api.objective-ai.io

userAgent.description: User-Agent header. Falls back to USER_AGENT env var.

xTitle.description: X-Title header. Falls back to X_TITLE env var.

httpReferer.description: HTTP-Referer header. Falls back to HTTP_REFERER env var.
